South Park Reveals Unexpected Pregnancy: Trump and Satan Expecting First Child A shocking plot twist unfolded in the latest episode of south Park , revealing that Donald Trump and Satan are in a relationship and expecting a child. The revelation, delivered in the final 90 seconds of Wednesday’s episode, “Wok Is Dead,” has ignited a firestorm of commentary and satire surrounding the former president and the media’s coverage of him.
A Tariff-Fueled Tale with Demonic Consequences The episode’s central narrative revolved around the economic impact of tariffs imposed by Trump’s management. The storyline followed Butters as he attempted to purchase a rare Labubu toy for his girlfriend, Red, only to be confronted with significantly inflated prices at City Pop Up-formerly known as City Wok.
“You think I pay tariff? You pay tariff! It’s not me, it’s your government,” a shop owner explained to Butters. “I don’t get fucked by tariff, you get fucked by tariff.In China, we call it hot potato!” The narrative then took a surreal turn, revealing that the tariffs had imbued the Labubus with demonic properties.
Did you know? -The episode’s plot cleverly intertwined economic policy with supernatural elements. The tariffs, a key policy of the Trump administration, were linked to demonic consequences within the show’s narrative. This juxtaposition served as a satirical commentary on real-world events.
Fox News and the Pursuit of a Salacious Story running parallel to the economic storyline was a pointed satire of Fox News ‘s unwavering support for Trump. The episode depicted Trump being greeted solely by Fox News reporters upon exiting air Force One, all eager to ask a single question: “Are you fucking Satan?”
The network afterward dedicated a segment to the inquiry, featuring Sean Hannity seemingly demonstrating potential methods of consummation. “The president is doing things no other president has done before,” exclaimed an anchor on Fox & Friends .
Confirmation and Reactions The episode culminated in a dark ritual performed by the South Park elementary school girls, summoning Trump and Satan to answer the burning question.
